text: Eight days ago this was fifty-one PDFs nobody reads. Tonight it's a live store with a price on it, a dataset at the edge, and a receipt for every file. Meta's models wrote it, checked it, and looked at every picture. One human read only the mechanics, and he was the only gate. The belt doesn't care how fast you move. It cares whether every byte matches its receipt. Fifty-one states, eight days, every frame made on the belt.
